test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
Select the segment in which a word has been INCORRECTLY used.

Is the Abominable Snowman a friction of the mountaineers’ imagination?
solution:
​The correct answer is **'****a friction'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The erroneous word in the given sentence is **friction.**
 
• **Friction **means the resistance that one surface or object encounters when moving over another.
 
• Thus, it does not fit the context of the sentence. 
 
• This makes segment '... a friction...' incorrect. 
 
• Thus, **option 3 **is incorrect. 
 
• The sentence can be corrected by using **fiction **which means something that is invented or untrue.

***Correct sentence - ****Is the Abominable Snowman a **fiction **of the mountaineers’ imagination?*
